scenarios.description: Precondition: actor owner creates in existing project with valid target/profile; fresh IDs.
invariants: Exactly one Task, policy, Wake, core event and receipt commit together; no spawn in transaction.

scenarios.description: Precondition: profile revision unavailable, all other create guards pass.
invariants: No Task, policy, Wake, event or successful receipt remains.

scenarios.description: Precondition: original create succeeded and current principal has read permission.
invariants: Replay returns original result with replayed=true; changing application does not create a second task or wake.

scenarios.description: Precondition: current claimed task revision2; caller is assignee but lacks valid current session proof.
invariants: No Run, core event or revision is committed by rejected binding validation.

scenarios.description: Precondition: session active at revision1, valid old proof; rotate then retry exact request with read credential and old proof.
invariants: proof_epoch advances once; replay is public historical result only; old proof rejects new writes.

scenarios.description: Precondition: valid source proof+target proof, binding revision1 current, target same actor/project and unbound.
invariants: Current binding moves once; old session new run writes rejected; core Run and Task revision unchanged.

scenarios.description: Precondition: session active, owns current assignment, valid proof at session revision1.
invariants: Session ended; Task/Assignment stay unchanged; new execution writes reject SESSION_ENDED until explicit transfer or release.

scenarios.description: Precondition: queued wake matches runner and target; reserve then task cancelled before authorize.
invariants: Authorize returns skipped; no spawn permission or task mutation.

scenarios.description: Precondition: authorized wake revision3; local attempted marker durable but spawn outcome unknown.

body.evidence: Local attempted marker exists; process outcome unknown

invariants: Wake unknown; no automatic re-dispatch; unresolved slot remains occupied; Task independent.

scenarios.description: Precondition: wake unknown rev4; operator has isolated runner and audited durable no-start evidence.

body.evidence: Runner isolated; persistent journal confirms no exec

invariants: Wake failed rev5; any stale late report conflicts; retry requires distinct explicit wake intent.

scenarios.description: Precondition: caller has read and snapshot fits limits; concurrent task change follows snapshot transaction.
invariants: Use returned event_cursor in real test (fixture cursor is symbolic); snapshot and following events have no lost commit; dedup handles follow replay.

scenarios.description: Precondition: cursor signed under prior log incarnation after backup restoration.
invariants: No fabricated new continuation; caller must take a new snapshot.

scenarios.description: Precondition: current actor enabled but credential has no admin; body structurally valid.
invariants: No profile/state change; being task issuer does not confer registry administration.

scenarios.description: Precondition: submitted task at revision4; caller is assignee only, not issuer, no prior successful receipt.
invariants: Submission remains pending; human/admin status cannot substitute for issuer.

scenarios.description: Precondition: policy rev1 and task rev1 both offered, issuer valid; claim races after policy commit.
invariants: Claim observes atomic updated policy; unchanged core revision alone cannot bypass policy; exactly one claimant may commit.

scenarios.description: Precondition: workspace contains more than1000 tasks or response exceeds16MiB.
invariants: No partial snapshot or misleading continuation watermark.

scenarios.description: Precondition: wake reserved at revision2 with valid target/profile; after this authorize commits, operator revokes profile before external spawn.
invariants: A process may still start after authorize; target must revalidate claim; cancellation is not physical stop.

scenarios.description: Precondition: session begin succeeds, create response lost, claim not yet attempted; durable intent retains original IDs.
invariants: Recover same successful create receipt; no new Task or session; resume next uncompleted operation only after current facts are checked.
